title: Diabetes care cascade from the two national sources, which disagree because of definitions (NFHS-5 uses self-report plus permissive random-glucose cutoffs; NNMS uses fasting glucose). Absolute numbers derived on ICMR-INDIAB's 101 million adults 20+ with diabetes (2021). Do not average the two sources.
source: NFHS-5: Varghese et al., JAMA Internal Medicine 2023. NNMS: Frontiers in Public Health 2022 (ICMR-NCDIR survey 2017-18). Base: ICMR-INDIAB-17, Lancet D&E 2023. Derived numbers are author-computed.
